question: pywatershed 3.0.0, the USGS Python implementation of PRMS, ships the Sagehen Creek domain (Sierra Nevada, test_data/sagehen_5yr) as its worked example. Run the example for water year 1981 (1 October 1980 to 30 September 1981) and plot, on one chart, the monthly basin-mean snow water equivalent, snowmelt and surface runoff. Say in which month the snowpack peaks and how large it is, when melt is strongest, how much of the melt leaves as surface runoff, and what that implies about how water reaches the stream in this basin.
